title: Velisse Font
author: Colourful
description:
Description:
Introducing Velisse, a refined and sophisticated display serif font designed for elegant, feminine, and high-end creative projects. Its graceful curves, dramatic thick-and-thin contrast, delicate serifs, and distinctive letterforms create a timeless luxury aesthetic.
Velisse is perfect for fashion branding, luxury logos, wedding invitations, beauty products, perfume packaging, editorial designs, magazine covers, posters, stationery, social media graphics, and premium packaging.
Whether you’re creating a sophisticated brand identity, an elegant invitation, or a fashionable editorial design, Velisse adds a polished and luxurious character to every project.
